usage: cypyc [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [-v] [--version]
             {transpile,compile,build,run,watch,hook} ...

Cypy compiler - A Python-like language that compiles to Cython

positional arguments:
  {transpile,compile,build,run,watch,hook}
                        Available commands
    transpile           Transpile Cypy source to Cython or C
    compile             Compile Cypy source to .pyd file
    build               Build entire project with cross-module type inference
    run                 Compile and run Cypy code
    watch               Start hot reload development server
    hook                Cypy hook for Python integration

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT   Output directory for generated files (default: output)
  -v, --verbose         Enable verbose output (default: False)
  --version             show program's version number and exit
